name: Busa JobHunt
description: Job-search profile, target companies, and outreach state

agentPrompts.label: What should I do next?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-jobhunt` skill in this folder, then open the desk and report where things stand — profile readiness, how many companies are queued/sent, and the next subcommand to run.

agentPrompts.label: Find new target companies
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-jobhunt` skill in this folder and follow its `research` workflow, then find twenty to thirty target companies with a real contact address and its source for each, draft one tailored email per company, and import them. Never buy, sell, or import a purchased contact list, and never bypass a paywall or anti-bot control to reach an address.

agentPrompts.label: Send my approved emails
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-jobhunt` skill in this folder and follow its `send` workflow, then send the letters I've approved from my own mailbox. Rehearse with `--test-to` before the first real send, report each failure per company instead of dropping it silently, and never send more than one email to the same company.
